summary: All time, past and still to come: 往古來今謂之宙.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Burke–Shaw trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 遠 takes the point farthest from the system’s centre, 孤 the most isolated of the rest, and 寂 the point nearest the centre. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: Space and Time, Folded into One Word
satellites.evidence: In modern Chinese and Japanese (uchū), 宇宙 is simply the universe. The classical pair named space and time separately; the modern word folds them into one, much as physics speaks of spacetime.
satellites.caveat: An analogy, not a history: the modern sense of 宇宙 did not come from relativity.
